overview.purpose: Pattern extraction service analyzes raw messages from activity turns to extract file paths, components, patterns, and complexity indicators for learning analytics

components.currentBehavior: Main entry point that extracts all patterns from activity messages. Returns PatternData with file_paths, components_modified, common_patterns, and complexity_indicators
components.desiredBehavior: ALREADY IMPLEMENTED - Provides comprehensive pattern analysis for post-execution insights
components.gap: NONE - Implementation is complete and validated

components.currentBehavior: Extracts file paths from messages using regex patterns. Handles relative paths (src/auth.py), absolute paths (/home/user/file.ts), quoted paths, and markdown references. Filters false positives and method calls
components.desiredBehavior: ALREADY IMPLEMENTED - Comprehensive file path extraction

components.currentBehavior: Extracts component names (functions, classes, methods) from messages. Detects function definitions (function X, def foo), class definitions (class Y), method calls (User.save), and explicit mentions. Filters common words and validates component names
components.desiredBehavior: ALREADY IMPLEMENTED - Identifies all component types
components.gap: NONE - Comprehensive component extraction with validation

components.currentBehavior: Identifies recurring patterns: error types (TypeError, ValueError, syntax error), code smells (duplicate code, long method), refactoring patterns (extract method, rename), and task types (fix bug, add feature, refactor)
components.desiredBehavior: ALREADY IMPLEMENTED - Pattern detection for learning insights

components.currentBehavior: Calculates complexity indicators: files_touched_count, estimated_lines_changed (based on keywords like 'added', 'removed', 'modified'), refactoring_depth (simple/moderate/complex), and task_type (fix/feature/refactor/test/docs)
components.gap: NONE - Provides accurate metrics for learning

components.currentBehavior: GET endpoint that queries impulse mapping records from database and calls extract_patterns() on each record's messages. Returns list of ImpulseMappingResponse with extracted patterns
components.desiredBehavior: ALREADY IMPLEMENTED - Provides pattern extraction endpoint

components.currentBehavior: Lightweight intent normalization for storage/matching. Replaces file paths with {file0} placeholders and numbers with {num0}. Used during turn recording
components.desiredBehavior: DISTINCT from extract_patterns() - This is for lightweight matching, extract_patterns() is for comprehensive analysis
components.gap: NONE - Both implementations serve different purposes as documented

components.currentBehavior: Data collection only - no learning algorithms. Buffers turn data and flushes to rpc-api via MetabobCLI.recordTurnLearning(). All learning logic delegated to server
components.desiredBehavior: ALREADY IMPLEMENTED - Client is thin wrapper
components.gap: NONE - Architecture separation is correct per impulse-learning-in-rpc-api-only spec

pythonDirect.code:
from server.services.pattern_extraction_service import extract_patterns

messages = [
    'Fixed bug in src/auth.py',
    'Updated User class with validation',
    'Refactored normalize_pattern method'
]

patterns = extract_patterns(messages)
print(patterns.file_paths)  # ['src/auth.py']
print(patterns.components_modified)  # ['User', 'normalize_pattern']
print(patterns.common_patterns)  # ['fix_bug', 'refactor']
print(patterns.complexity_indicators)  # {files_touched_count: 1, ...}

implementationNotes: Pattern extraction is ONLY performed in rpc-api, not in opencode client
Two distinct implementations: normalize_pattern() for lightweight matching, extract_patterns() for comprehensive analysis
Extract_patterns() is called on-demand via /impulse-mappings endpoint, not during turn recording (performance optimization)
Service handles empty messages gracefully (returns empty PatternData)
Regex patterns are comprehensive but may have false positives - validation harness ensures quality
Complexity indicators use heuristics (keyword counting) - reasonable approximations, not exact measurements
File path extraction distinguishes between files (src/auth.py) and method calls (User.save) using extension matching
